round.description: Order of the races held that season (may differ from the official round if an event was cancelled).

scheduled_laps.description: Race distance. From data/reference/scheduled_laps.csv if checked by hand, else the winner's lap count (actual distance; wrong for shortened races).

stint.description: Stint counter, starts at 1, rises after each tyre change.

tyre_life.description: tyre_age_at_start + laps into the stint + 1 (1 on the first lap of a new set). Includes laps from earlier sessions for used sets.

lap_time_s.description: Measured lap time. Not a measure of tyre wear.

lap_start_session_s.description: Seconds from the session's scheduled start to lap start.

lap_end_session_s.description: Seconds from scheduled start to lap end (next lap start if duration missing).

position_end_of_lap.description: Latest running position at or before lap end.

track_status_raw.description: Codes of every neutralisation period overlapping the lap, rebuilt from race-control messages (1 green, 2 yellow, 4 SC, 5 red, 6 VSC).

compound_relative.description: SOFT/MEDIUM/HARD (or INTERMEDIATE/WET). Missing where it cannot be assigned.

compound_map_method.description: How compound_relative was set: reported, rank_of_observed_2018, ambiguous_*, missing.

flag_yellow.description: Yellow flag at some point in the lap.

flag_sc.description: Safety car at some point in the lap.

flag_red.description: Red flag at some point in the lap.

flag_vsc.description: Virtual safety car deployed or ending in the lap.

flag_track_status_missing.description: No status recorded for the lap.

flag_pit_in.description: In-lap: the lap before an out-lap. Cross-checked against the pit table.

flag_deleted.description: Lap time deleted by race control (and not reinstated). Known only after the fact.

flag_not_accurate.description: Always false with OpenF1 (no equivalent field). Kept for source compatibility.

flag_fastf1_generated.description: Always false with OpenF1. Kept for source compatibility.

flag_non_slick.description: Not on slick tyres, or compound unknown.

flag_compound_relative_missing.description: Relative compound not assigned. Informational; not an exclusion by itself.

flag_beyond_scheduled.description: Lap past the race distance (extra row after the flag, or distance undercounted).

flag_post_neutralisation.description: First lap after an SC, VSC or red-flag lap.

flag_rain.description: Rainfall reported at the latest sample before lap start.

flag_pace_outlier.description: Robust z-score of the residual from a Theil-Sen line on lap number within driver-stint, above OUTLIER_Z. Uses the whole stint: sample selection only, never a feature.

grid_position.description: Starting grid slot. Final results are not joined.

air_temp_c.description: Latest air temperature at or before lap start.

track_temp_c.description: Latest track temperature at or before lap start.

humidity_pct.description: Latest humidity at or before lap start.

pressure_mbar.description: Latest air pressure at or before lap start.

rainfall.description: Rainfall indicator at the latest sample.

wind_speed_ms.description: Latest wind speed at or before lap start.

weather_age_s.description: Time between the weather sample and lap start.

is_clean_green.description: No default exclusion flag set (pace outlier not included). Default research sample for scored targets.

is_clean_green_strict.description: is_clean_green and not a pace outlier. Sensitivity sample.

exclusion_reason.description: Semicolon list of every exclusion flag set on the lap, pace outlier included.

lt_lag0.description: Lap time of lap t (any status).

lt_lag1.description: Lap time of lap t-1 (any status).

last_green_lt.description: Most recent real-time-green lap in this stint.

roll_mean_green_3.description: Mean of the last 3 real-time-green laps in this stint.

roll_std_green_5.description: Std. dev. of the last 5 real-time-green laps in this stint.

trend_slope_green_5.description: OLS slope of lap time on tyre life, last 5 green laps (needs 3).

green_laps_in_stint.description: Count of real-time-green laps so far in the stint.

target_tyre_life.description: Tyre life on lap t+1 if the driver stays out.

prev_stint_compound.description: Relative compound of the previous stint.

pit_stops_so_far.description: Tyre changes made before lap t.

laps_remaining_sched.description: Laps left to the scheduled finish. Main fuel-load proxy.

field_green_median_recent.origin: other drivers, ended <= end of lap t
field_green_median_recent.description: Median of other drivers' green laps that ended in the last 120 s.

is_rt_green.description: Lap t had no real-time exclusion flag (pit, SC/VSC/red, yellow, restart, wet, rain). Used for lap sequences.

target_lap_number.description: Lap number of the target lap.

target_valid.description: Target is the next lap, same stint, and a clean green lap.

target_valid_strict.description: target_valid and lap t+1 is not a pace outlier. Sensitivity sample.
